newsitem.title: POLAND: Nomura takes 1.6 mln Polish Impexmetal shares.
newsitem.headline: Nomura takes 1.6 mln Polish Impexmetal shares.

text.p: Investment bank Nomura International Plc took 1,594,586 shares of the initial public offering of Polish metals trader Impexmetal SA at 36 zlotys each, Impexmetal said in a statement on Monday.
Last month Nomura underwrote the shares but no stand-by fee or discount from the issue price was envisaged.

Impexmetal was offering 3,189,171 shares and the offer was oversubscribed. The treasury ministry offered additionally 2,976,560 of its 7,441,400 shares at the minimum price of 36 zlotys, but had not yet released the subscription's results.

Under the underwriting agreement with Nomura Impexmetal was obliged to limit by the end of May its liabilities to $51.3 million and to keep them at or below this level as long as Nomura holds 10 percent or more Impexmetal shares.
Impexmetal also agreed to consult all major equity investments and acquisitions with Nomura as long as it held at least 10 percent of Impexmetal.
